title: Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.31571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. translated_title: 安全自动形式化：基于蕴含图的充分性与必要性
translated_abstract: 自动形式化是将自然语言陈述翻译为能够捕捉其意图的公式，这一过程依赖于陈述的上下文，即用于消除歧义的背景知识。大语言模型（LLM）使自动形式化变得实用，但其概率性输出不具备任何形式化保证。我们提出了实现安全自动形式化的技术，用于认证单侧逻辑充分性：对意图而言充分的公式可安全地强制执行，而对意图而言必要的公式可安全地加以依赖。我们利用大语言模型生成候选公式，并按逻辑强度将其组织在蕴含图（Entailment Graph, EG）中，该排序由求解器判定。每条边携带一个残差和一个余残差，即蕴含序的两个伴随算子，二者均仅由候选池决定。在给定上下文中，通过两次搜索分别返回充分前沿（蕴含该陈述的最弱候选公式）和必要前沿（被该陈述蕴含的最强候选公式）；每一步仅需一次局部检查。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种安全自动形式化方法：用LLM生成候选公式并构建由求解器判定的蕴含图，通过搜索充分前沿与必要前沿认证单侧逻辑充分性，使得对意图充分的公式可安全执行、对意图必要的公式可安全依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes safe autoformalization by generating candidate formulas with LLMs and organizing them in a solver-decided Entailment Graph, where searching for the sufficient and necessary frontiers certifies one-sided logical adequacy—making sufficient formulas safe to enforce and necessary formulas safe to rely on.
